fields.latestPosition: File to be sent to PCS to implement on an ongoing basis through to December 2026.
fields.nextAction: Issue file to PCS and set the recurring schedule.
fields.why: Pilgan PlantSCADA trending has been extremely unstable and often cannot start until trend files are cleared. Trend files are configured one file per day for 365 days – over 11 million files – all transitioning at 00:00 UTC. With PI Historian in place, a year of SCADA trends is no longer needed.
fields.design:
- Change trend file size from 1 day to 1 week
- Reduce trend file storage from 365 days to 13 weeks (under ~400k files)
- Stagger trend file cutover times to reduce drive load
- Review performance and adjust file size/storage if needed
fields.impact: Built-in SCADA trends will hold 13 weeks of history; older data comes from PI Historian.
fields.scheduleNote: Implement on an ongoing basis through to December 2026.
